newsitem.title: BELGIUM: QUICK SEES 30-35% DROP IN 96 NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: QUICK SEES 30-35% DROP IN 96 NET PROFIT.

text.p: Belgian fast-food chain Quick Restaurants on Monday confirmed its forecast for a 30 to 35 percent fall in net profit for the full year 1996 compared to the previous year.
The company said earlier this year that business had been hit sharply by the scare over British beef.
Quick predicted a 10 to 12 percent rise in sales for the full year, which would see the opening of 60 new restaurants.

Quick, which said it was always able to certify the quality and origin of the beef served in its restaurants, said in a statement it believed the fears of consumers about beef should progressively diminish.
"The fast food market keeping all its potential for development, Quick expects to re-discover a more sustained rhythm of growth from 1997," the statement said.
